attributes.action: Consult on extending the EYFS or creating a kindergarten stage to age seven
attributes.additional_details: We believe England needs a national conversation about continuity in children’s education from nursery through Reception and Years 1–2. The consultation should explore how play, relationships and child development could underpin this phase, comparing an extended EYFS with a distinct kindergarten stage. It should consider learning, wellbeing, SEND inclusion, assessment, workforce training and funding, informed by research and the experiences of children, families and educators.
attributes.background: Launch a national consultation on extending the Early Years Foundation Stage to age seven or establishing a distinct kindergarten stage for ages 3–7. Involve children, families, educators and researchers, and publish findings and proposed next steps.
